caption: The drawing is rendered in pencil or graphite on a light beige or off-white paper. At the center is a rectangular, architectural structure with six vertical cylindrical columns, set on a solid base and topped with a flat entablature. The structure is shown in three-quarter view, with shadows indicating depth and curvature of the columns. To the top-left is a square diagram of a grid-like surface, annotated with a scale and featuring rows of shaded, circular indents. The bottom-left corner has another square diagram depicting a similar grid but with smaller, less pronounced circular features. The bottom-right contains a simplified front view of the central structure, displaying the same six columns and rectangular base. The drawing includes ruler markings and handwritten scale notations next to the diagrams. The composition has fine, precise lines, and employs minimal shading, focusing on architectural and geometric forms.
